chapterTitle: FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 06 (Organic & Applied Chemistry Focus)
subject: chemistry-10

questions.question: Which of the following organic functional groups contains a nitrogen atom directly bonded to a carbonyl group?
questions.explanation: Amides contain the $-CO-NH_2$ linkage connecting a carbonyl carbon to nitrogen.

questions.question: Ethene reacts with hydrogen in the presence of nickel catalyst at 250°C to form:
questions.explanation: Hydrogenation of ethene ($C_2H_4 + H_2 \xrightarrow{Ni} C_2H_6$) yields saturated ethane.

questions.question: What is the IUPAC name of the simplest ketone, commonly known as acetone?
questions.explanation: Acetone has 3 carbon atoms ($CH_3COCH_3$), named propanone in IUPAC nomenclature.

questions.question: Which polymer is formed by the addition polymerization of vinyl chloride?
questions.explanation: Polymerization of vinyl chloride ($CH_2=CHCl$) produces PVC, widely used in piping.

questions.question: Which carbohydrate is stored in human liver and muscles as an emergency energy reserve?
questions.explanation: Glycogen (animal starch) is the glucose storage polysaccharide in animals.

questions.question: What type of chemical reaction converts vegetable oil into solid vegetable ghee?
questions.explanation: Hydrogenation adds $H_2$ across double bonds of unsaturated oils to form solid saturated fats.

questions.question: In the Solvay process, sodium bicarbonate precipitates out primarily due to:

options.A: Low solubility at 15°C and common ion effect of $Na^+$

questions.explanation: Sparingly soluble $NaHCO_3$ precipitates out in chilled ammoniacal brine due to the common ion effect.

questions.question: Which petroleum fraction is refined for use as aviation jet aircraft fuel?
questions.explanation: Kerosene ($C_{10}-C_{12}$) is refined into aviation turbine fuel.

questions.question: The percentage of nitrogen in urea fertilizer ($NH_2CONH_2$) is:
questions.explanation: Urea contains ~46.6% nitrogen by mass, the highest among solid nitrogen fertilizers.

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of chloroform?
Which functional group is present in carboxylic acids?
questions.explanation: Carboxylic acids contain the carboxyl group ($-COOH$).

questions.question: Acetylene produces a smoky, luminous flame when burned in air because:

options.A: It has a high carbon-to-hydrogen ratio (92.3% carbon)

questions.explanation: High carbon percentage causes unburnt incandescent carbon particles, producing a sooty flame.
